requirements.description: CRSP daily stock returns, prices, volumes for MAX computation
CRSP monthly stock returns for portfolio formation and one-month-ahead excess returns
CRSP names PIT for shrcd/exchcd/siccd lookups
Compustat annual fundamentals for book equity, ROA, GP, NOA, accruals, asset growth, INV/AT, net stock issuance
Compustat quarterly fundamentals for IBQ (ROE numerator) and IB (compustat fundamentals)
CRSP-Compustat linking table for gvkey/permno mapping
Fama-French three-factor monthly (Mkt-RF, SMB, HML, RF)
Pastor-Stambaugh (2003) liquidity factor LIQ (needed for FFCPS and FF6PS)
Stambaugh-Yuan (2017) MGMT and PERF mispricing factors (needed for SY model)
Daniel-Hirshleifer-Sun (2020) FIN and PEAD behavioral factors (needed for DHS model)
Institutional ownership data from Thomson Reuters 13F (s34)

blocking_issues.reason: No PS_LIQ factor in ClickHouse. FFCPS (FFC4 + LIQ) and FF6PS (FF6 + LIQ) columns of Tables 1 and 6 cannot be replicated without this factor.
blocking_issues.recommendation: Skip FFCPS and FF6PS columns in Tables 1 and 6. Replicate FF3, FFC4, FF5, FF6 alpha columns which only require standard FF factors. Document the substitution in assumptions.md as [MISSING-LIQ-FACTOR].

blocking_issues.reason: Stambaugh-Yuan (2017) mispricing factors (MGMT, PERF) are not in ClickHouse; the paper sources them from Robert Stambaugh's website. SY alpha columns of Tables 1 and 6 cannot be replicated.
blocking_issues.recommendation: Skip SY alpha columns. The paper's main claim about MAX vanishing under SY/DHS is not replicable; instead report FF3/FFC4/FF5/FF6 alphas. Document in assumptions.md as [MISSING-SY-FACTORS].

blocking_issues.reason: Daniel-Hirshleifer-Sun (2020) behavioral factors (FIN, PEAD) are not in ClickHouse; the paper sources them from Lin Sun's website. DHS alpha columns cannot be replicated.
blocking_issues.recommendation: Skip DHS alpha columns. Document in assumptions.md as [MISSING-DHS-FACTORS].

blocking_issues.reason: FF6 model requires MOM (from Carhart factor) on top of FF5. factors_na_2025 has RMW/CMA but no MOM column. We can still construct FF6 as FF5+MOM by joining with four_factor.
blocking_issues.recommendation: Construct FF6 factors in SQL by joining ff.five_factor with ff.four_factor on date to get the MOM column. Document the join in assumptions.md as [FF6-FROM-JOIN].
